segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome back to EnglishPod.
My name is Catherine and today we have an elementary level lesson for you.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为您准备了一个小学课程。

segments.en: We are going to talk about winter but specifically about the clothes you wear during winter when it's very, very cold outside.
segments.zh: 我们将谈论冬天，但特别是关于你在冬天穿的衣服，外面非常非常冷。

segments.en: That's right and I hear you're not too familiar with some of these practices because where you come from you don't really have winter.
segments.zh: 没错，我听说您对其中一些做法不太熟悉，因为您来自哪里并没有真正的冬天。

segments.en: We have dry season and rainy season but same temperature.
segments.zh: 我们有旱季和雨季，但温度相同。

segments.en: Well Chicago definitely has a snowy season so I'm very familiar with these things.
segments.zh: 好吧，芝加哥肯定有一个雪季，所以我对这些事情非常熟悉。

segments.en: So let's jump right into today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们直接进入今天的对话。

segments.en: We'll be hearing it one time and in a minute we'll be back to talk about it.
segments.zh: 我们会听到一次，一分钟后我们会回来谈论它。

segments.en: You'll be too cold without mittens.
With that wind you're going to catch a cold.
segments.zh: 外面风这么大，你会着凉的。

segments.en: So there were a couple of different items of clothing that we saw in this dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这次对话中看到了几件不同的服装。

segments.en: So let's look at them now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们现在用语言外卖来看看它们。

segments.en: Okay, well, first of all we have mom and Jimmy.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先我们有妈妈和吉米。
吉米是一个男孩的名字。

segments.en: And mom is saying goodbye to him, but first she wants him to put on clothes.
segments.zh: 妈妈和他说再见，但首先她想让他穿上衣服。

segments.en: So the first item, the first thing she asks him to put on is a hat.
segments.zh: 所以第一件事，她要求他戴上的第一件事是一顶帽子。

segments.en: Now you probably have seen like a baseball cap or many different types of hats.
segments.zh: 现在您可能已经看到了像棒球帽或许多不同类型的帽子。

segments.en: And sometimes in other languages they have specific names for a hat for winter, right?
segments.zh: 有时在其他语言中，他们有特定的冬天帽子名称，对吧？

segments.en: But in English it's a hat.
segments.zh: 但在英语中，它是一顶帽子。

segments.en: Anything that covers your head is a hat.
segments.zh: 任何遮住你的头的东西都是一顶帽子。

segments.en: That's kind of like the category.
So maybe this one is a warm wool hat, but in the end it's a hat.
segments.zh: 所以也许这是一顶温暖的羊毛帽子，但最终它是一顶帽子。

segments.en: So he's put on the hat.
Now what else is he going to put on?
Well, we need to keep our fingers warm.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们需要保持手指温暖。

segments.en: So there are two kinds of ways to keep your fingers warm.
segments.zh: 所以有两种方法可以让你的手指保持温暖。

segments.en: And the way in this dialogue that the boy keeps his fingers warm is with mittens.
segments.zh: 男孩保持手指温暖的对话方式是手套。

segments.en: All right, so mittens you put on your hands.
segments.zh: 好吧，你把手套放在手上。

segments.en: Now what's the difference between mittens and gloves?
segments.zh: 现在手套和手套有什么区别？

segments.en: Okay, gloves have special places for each finger.
segments.zh: 好吧，手套的每个手指都有特殊的位置。

segments.en: One, two, three, four, five on each hand.
And mittens, there's two spaces, one for your thumb and one for all your other fingers.
segments.zh: 还有手套，有两个空间，一种用于拇指，另一种用于所有其他手指。

segments.en: So that means you can't really hold things.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着你不能真正持有东西。

segments.en: So you kind of look like a penguin or something like that.
segments.zh: 所以你看起来有点像企鹅或类似的东西。

segments.en: Yeah, you look like a, yeah, exactly like a penguin.
segments.zh: 是的，你看起来像一只，是的，就像企鹅一样。

segments.en: Adults don't wear mittens because adults need to hold things like keys and phones and car steering wheels.
segments.zh: 成年人不戴手套，因为成年人需要拿着钥匙、电话和汽车方向盘之类的东西。

segments.en: So in this case, mittens is usually for children.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，手套通常是为儿童准备的。

segments.en: And well, the mother is still a little bit worried.
segments.zh: 好吧，妈妈还是有点担心。

segments.en: So she tells him to wear a scarf.
Okay, a scarf is a long, usually made of wool, a long piece of fabric that you put around your neck to keep your neck warm.
segments.zh: 好吧，围巾是一条长长的，通常由羊毛制成，一块长长的织物，你放在脖子上以保持脖子温暖。

segments.en: Okay, and he's put on the mittens, the scarf, the hat, and he's missing some earmuffs.
segments.zh: 好吧，他戴上了手套、围巾、帽子，而且他缺少一些耳罩。

segments.en: Okay, this is a little funny because usually if you're wearing a hat, you don't need earmuffs.
segments.zh: 好吧，这有点好笑，因为通常如果你戴着帽子，你不需要耳罩。

segments.en: But earmuffs are like headphones, but they keep your ears warm.
segments.zh: 但是耳罩就像耳机，但它们让您的耳朵保持温暖。

segments.en: And we wear these, they don't cover your head, they just cover your ears.
segments.zh: 我们戴这些，它们不会遮住你的头，它们只是遮住你的耳朵。

segments.en: And usually they're just two round circles over your ears.
segments.zh: 通常它们只是你耳朵上的两个圆形圆圈。

segments.en: So as you say, exactly, they look like big earphones and they keep your ears warm.
segments.zh: 所以正如你所说，它们看起来像大耳机，它们让你的耳朵保持温暖。

segments.en: Now, as you say, you usually don't wear this if you're wearing a hat because, well, you would put your ears inside your hat, right?
segments.zh: 现在，正如你所说，如果你戴着帽子，你通常不会戴这个，因为，好吧，你会把耳朵放在你的帽子里，对吧？

segments.en: So it looks pretty silly if he's wearing all of this together.
segments.zh: 所以如果他把所有这些都穿在一起，这看起来很愚蠢。

segments.en: And so those four key items, those four key pieces of clothing are for our language takeaway today.
segments.zh: 所以这四个关键项目，那四件关键的衣服是我们今天的语言外卖。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to this dialogue again, and we'll come back soon to talk about Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们很快就会回来谈论 Fluency Builder。

segments.en: No, wait, you'll be too cold without mittens.
segments.zh: 不，等等，没有手套你会太冷。

segments.en: Hold on, with that wind you're gonna catch a cold.
segments.zh: 坚持住，用那风，你会感冒的。

segments.en: Oh, and earmuffs, put these on.
So now let's take a look at four key phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看关于 Fluency Builder 的四个关键短语。

segments.en: Okay, this first phrase, as I said before, has to do with the mom and the boy saying goodbye to each other.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如我之前所说，第一个短语与妈妈和男孩说再见有关。

segments.en: So he says, all right, see ya.
Okay, so see as in to look, to, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以看看看，对，对吗？

segments.en: Okay, so this is a very spoken language way of saying you.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一种非常口头化的语言表达你的方式。

segments.en: So we could say, see you later, but if you want to make it shorter, you can say, see ya.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说，稍后见，但如果你想让它更短，你可以说，见。

segments.en: And then what's our next way of saying goodbye?
segments.zh: 那么我们下一个说再见的方式是什么？

segments.en: No, hold on is our next phrase and this is a way to say wait.
segments.zh: 不，坚持是我们的下一个短语，这是一种表达等待的方式。

segments.en: So you just say hold on, it means wait.
segments.zh: 所以你只是说坚持，这意味着等待。

segments.en: It's just a little bit more casual.
You have to use these two words together.
segments.zh: 你必须同时使用这两个词。

segments.en: So like I said before with Marco who wants to go fast, I could say, hold on.
segments.zh: 所以就像我之前对马可说的那样，我可以说，坚持住。

segments.en: And now you got to be careful because you're going to catch a cold.
segments.zh: 现在你必须小心，因为你会感冒。

segments.en: Okay, so a cold is when you cough, you have a sore throat, it's starting to get cold outside and you don't feel well.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以当你咳嗽时，感冒了，喉咙痛，外面开始变冷，你感觉不舒服。

segments.en: So you have a runny nose.
And most people get this every year.
segments.zh: 大多数人每年都会得到这个。

segments.en: But you don't get a cold, you catch a cold.
segments.zh: 但你不会感冒，你会感冒。

segments.en: So catch is the same word we use for when we talk about sports like throwing and catching.
segments.zh: 所以当我们谈论投掷和捕捉等运动时，我们使用的词是同一个词。

segments.en: It's almost like it just hits you.
segments.zh: 这几乎就像它刚刚击中你一样。

segments.en: So that's really important what you just said because you don't use the verb get.
segments.zh: 所以这很重要，因为你不使用动词 get。

segments.en: Or if you say that you were sick last week because you had a cold, you would say, oh, I caught a cold or I had a cold.
segments.zh: 或者如果你说你上周因为感冒而生病了，你会说，哦，我感冒了，或者我感冒了。

segments.en: So remember present tense, I catch a cold.
segments.zh: 所以记住现在时，我感冒了。

segments.en: Past tense, I caught a cold last week.
And our last phrase for fluency builder is here we go.
segments.zh: 我们的 Fluency Builder 的最后一句话就在这里。

segments.en: Okay, so when do we hear this phrase?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们什么时候听到这个短语？

segments.en: So the mother says to the boy, put these on, here we go.
segments.zh: 所以妈妈对男孩说，穿上这些，我们走吧。

segments.en: So she's doing something with him.
segments.zh: 所以她正在和他做点什么。

segments.en: She's helping him put his earmuffs on.
And here we go is a way to say, okay, I've finished.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们是一种说，好吧，我已经完成了。

segments.en: Okay, your earmuffs are on you.
segments.zh: 好吧，你的耳罩在你身上。

segments.en: So we say here we go.
So maybe I'm on my computer and I have a problem and I'm waiting, waiting, waiting, waiting, waiting.
segments.zh: 所以也许我在我的电脑上，我有一个问题，我在等待，等待，等待，等待，等待。

segments.en: And you know when the bar's loading.
Or sometimes a waitress will come and serve you food and say, here we go.
segments.zh: 或者有时女服务员会来为您提供食物并说，我们去吧。

segments.en: So this is a way to say what you've been waiting for.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种说出你一直在等待的方式。

segments.en: So I think it's time for us to listen to this dialogue one last time before we come back.
segments.zh: 所以我认为是时候在我们回来之前最后一次听这个对话了。

segments.en: No, wait, you'll be too cold without mittens.
segments.zh: 不，等等，没有手套你会太冷。

segments.en: With that wind, you're going to catch a cold.
So as you mentioned, in Chicago it's very, very cold.
segments.zh: 正如你所提到的，在芝加哥，它非常非常冷。

segments.en: So I imagine you had all of these winter clothes, right?
segments.zh: 所以我想你有所有这些冬装，对吧？

segments.en: And it's funny because I remember being a small child and my mother doing this to me, putting on snow pants and boots and earmuffs and hats and gloves and scarves.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，因为我记得小时候，我妈妈对我这样做，穿上雪裤、靴子、耳罩、帽子、手套和围巾。

segments.en: And all of a sudden, it's so hot inside because you're wearing everything.
segments.zh: 突然间，里面很热，因为你穿着所有东西。

segments.en: And so you can't even walk like you were saying.
segments.zh: 所以你甚至不能像你说的那样走路。

segments.en: You look like a penguin walking out the door.
segments.zh: 你看起来像一只走出门的企鹅。

segments.en: And then you get to school and you're sweating, right?
segments.zh: 然后你去学校，你出汗了，对吧？

segments.en: And so in school, we had to take, we had a special room and we had to take everything off because there's snow everywhere and snow can be very dangerous because it melts and it turns into water.
segments.zh: 所以在学校里，我们不得不拿，我们有一个特殊的房间，我们不得不把所有东西都拿走，因为到处都是雪，雪很危险，因为它融化了，变成了水。

segments.en: Okay, so I have very strong memories of all of this, putting them on, taking them off and just being warm all the time.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我对这一切有着非常强烈的记忆，穿上它们，脱下它们，一直保持温暖。

segments.en: Well, yeah, when it's cold or you live in a place with cold weather, you have to have these items of clothing because otherwise you might catch a cold.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，当天气寒冷或你住在寒冷天气的地方时，你必须拥有这些衣服，否则你可能会感冒。

segments.en: Exactly, so I hope that no one out there catches a cold, but if you want some suggestions, wear a scarf, cover your neck, that's the most important, your head and your scarf are the most important.
segments.zh: 没错，所以我希望那里没有人会感冒，但如果你想要一些建议，戴上围巾，捂住脖子，那是最重要的，你的头和你的围巾是最重要的。

segments.en: All right, and if you guys have any other questions or comments, you can visit our website, englishpod.com and we'll see everyone there.
segments.zh: 好的，如果你们有任何其他问题或意见，您可以访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，我们会在那里见到每个人。
